title: D9b: implied-original uses published -09 MessageId
description: Extends D9 (follow repo .cbor files). The WG's examples/implied-original.cbor/.pretty carry the -07 Original MessageId 01b00844..., while implied-original.edn and draft §5.1 give the -09 value 017ce548..., which the §3.3 algorithm reproduces. D9 was written for mimiContent hex dumps; applied here it would expect an ID the -09 algorithm cannot produce. Chosen: MessageId tests expect the published -09 value 017ce548..., and a separate assertion records that the vendored .cbor still carries the stale value, so a regenerated upstream file breaks the test visibly. wg: mimid-1wgh.37.20.
